what: AI tool modules that still write straight to PostgREST instead of through a registered write intent
command: for app in crm7 conduit; do grep -rlE "method: *'(POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE)'|\.(insert|update|upsert)\(" --include='*.ts' "$app/src/lib/ai/tools" | grep -v '\.test\.ts$'; done | wc -l
command_note: Recursive (-r over the directory with --include) so a tool added in a subdirectory is counted. The earlier form globbed *.ts at one level; it returned the same 20 today because the only nested directory is conduit/src/lib/ai/tools/__tests__, which is excluded either way.
